conditions: Pointer or reference arguments in the graphics-function rule stated in §4.
limitations: The surrounding text gives a different set for kernel functions. This claim does not expand to other shader argument categories or establish GPU-family availability.

triggers: Publisher correction, applicable new edition, changed exact representation or contrary evidence.

statement: For pointer or reference arguments to the graphics functions described in §4, the MSL 4.1 specification requires an address-space attribute and names device and constant as the permitted address spaces.
